title: Fourier expansion of a coordinate Laplacian
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$, with distinguished constant basis index $0_B$. For any coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, function $f:(\Omega^n)\to\mathbb R$, and point $x\in\Omega^n$, the product coordinate Laplacian of $f$ at $x$ is $\sum_{a\in\iota^n:\,a_i\ne 0_B}\widehat f(a)\prod_{j=1}^n B_{a_j}(x_j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
